answer: Each identity in the registry must post a bond held in escrow under a single hardware-backed key, with the grant receipt hashed into a crystal record. A sybil attacker locking 500 tokens per identity forfeits 100 percent of each bond after a 30-epoch challenge window. Copying a credential splits one stake across many claims, so 500 tokens per fake identity and a shared vault slash keep marginal cost above any per-identity gain, and a comet marker flags the repeated key.
